title: Abagcini Besivuno Esiyimfihlo
intro: Ezweni elinohlaza, iqembu labantu lenza icebo eliyimfihlo ebumnyameni. Babenenhloso efanayo, kodwa inhloso yabo yayingeyona elungile neze. Babengazi ukuthi kwakuzoba khona ushintsho oluvela kuNkulunkulu njengoba belele.
clues: Senze isinqumo esiqinile, sicabanga ukuthi icebo lethu alinaphutha.
Sasihlose ukuphuma kusenesikhathi, ngaphambi kokuba abanye baqale ukuxokozela.
Saqala icebo elivundile, siqiniseka ngezinto esizidingayo.
Njengoba sifika lapho siya khona, sayithola ingenalutho futhi ingenalutho, ngakho sacabanga ukuthi silahlekile.
Sabe sesibona ukuthi ngempela kwakuyindawo yethu, futhi sakhala ngokuphelelwa yithemba, sisolana ngokulahlekelwa kwethu.
Sasifungile ngalolo suku ekuseni ukuthi sizokhipha abampofu esivunweni sethu, kodwa isijeziso sika-Allah safika kithi silele, saguqula ingadi yethu yaba yincithakalo.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
